decision.reason: The archived SYSTEM object does not contain the full MOC transport operator and archived SOUR and FLUX are not a same-point equation pair. Reapplying the production sweep is solver-consistent but not implementation-independent and, without an inverse-operator bound, is not a state-error bound. A continuous REAL64 working lane changes arithmetic representation only and directly tests the observed binary32 working-state limitation.

locked_case.active_group_contract: On each direct-vector call NGIND is the ordered contiguous set IGDEB..370 and NGEFF=371-IGDEB; NGEFF may decrease from 370 as thermal groups terminate.
locked_case.mccg_active_subset_contract: Within a gathered NGIND set, MCGMRE NCONV may be any ordered non-contiguous subset as individual groups meet the MCCG criterion; the REAL64 lane must preserve that mask.

exponential_branch.scheme: NON CYCLIC - STIS 1 - SC SCHEME - TABULATED EXP

frozen_inactive_branches.MCGABGR_to_MCGACA: inactive because MCGMRE calls MCGFL1 with LAST=false, so MACFLG and ACA group rebalancing remain false
frozen_inactive_branches.MCGFMC: inactive because STIS=1 selects MCGFST instead of ordinary volume normalization

precision_contract.immutable_operator_inputs: Every frozen source, cross section, geometry and tracking input retains its archived storage kind. Binary32 values are promoted exactly when mixed with binary64 state, existing binary64 values remain binary64, and no operator input is rewritten by the lane.
precision_contract.frozen_transport_kernel_mixed_precision: The selected MCGFCF to MCGFFIR to MCGSCA operator path is unchanged. In particular MCGSCA TAU=REAL(TAUD) and its binary32 exponential-table arithmetic remain part of the frozen operator definition; they are not mutable iteration-state round trips.
precision_contract.compatibility_output: One terminal conversion to the existing GANLIB LCM type-2 FLUX/SOUR records after strict termination; this mirror is consumed by the unchanged SPOD coupling.
precision_contract.scope_name: continuous REAL64 radial inner solve with one terminal public-output rounding
precision_contract.not_claimed: an all-REAL64 Dragon solver or an all-REAL64 online SPOD map
required_path_nodes: FLU2DR eight-slice state, fixed/off-group source construction, state updates and terminal norms
MCGFLX iteration state and convergence quantities
MCGMRE PHIIN/QFR/RHS/GAR, correction accumulation and convergence quantities
MCGABG control-affecting norms and MCGPRA/MSRLUS1 correction path
FLUBAL double rebalancing matrix solved by ALSBD
FLU2AC flux update and acceleration scalar
type-4 authoritative and one-time type-2 terminal archive adapter
forbidden_round_trips: type-2 LCM write followed by a type-2 read before terminal acceptance
binary32 convergence norm or acceleration factor controlling the REAL64 lane
diagnostic capture that downcasts a solver input
precision_contract.implementation_form: separate suffixed routines or explicit interfaces; changing an unversioned F77 callee kind while retaining a binary32 caller is forbidden

inherited_aca_cutoff.required_instrumentation: For every live Boolean guard containing EPSMAX, EPSINF, or EPS2 derived from EPSMAX, evaluate a diagnostic counterfactual with EPSMAX=0 using the same finite operands. Increment cutoff_active exactly when the production and counterfactual Boolean outcomes differ. This includes zeroing, stopping and lucky-breakdown/WI branches. The counterfactual may not alter the production action or state.
inherited_aca_cutoff.interpretation: This is a pre-existing Dragon solver cutoff, not a new SPOD coefficient. cutoff_active != 0 prevents attribution to working precision and cannot be repaired by tuning the cutoff.

allowed_actions: run synthetic unit tests without Dragon or a transport sweep
required_gate: every required path node is represented in a machine-readable precision manifest
no mutable-state binary32 round trip exists before terminal acceptance
all cross-kind calls have explicit checked interfaces
legacy OFF is the default and unsupported branches fail closed
no physical term, solver control, iteration order or acceptance rule changes
the inherited ACA cutoff is instrumented but unchanged
the OFF-arm ordered non-timing scientific-log parser is frozen before any feasibility run
tests prove malformed or incomplete manifests fail closed

phase_B_plane1_feasibility.reason_for_plane: Plane 1 is the already frozen radial-floor and raw-MOC evidence lane; it is not selected as a worst plane or a causal location.

common_restart.role: forensic plane-1 cap state used only as a common numerical initial vector

legacy_OFF_identity_arm.required_result: bitwise-identical standard scientific output and exact equality of ordered non-timing scientific records under a parser frozen before the feasibility run; the raw reference-log hash is provenance, not the comparison rule

REAL64_ON_arm.required_result: strict existing FLU terminal gate before the unchanged iteration cap; finite positive scalar flux; passing existing source, layout and structural checks; finite nonnegative reported balance diagnostics without a magnitude gate; complete type-4 audit state; and cutoff_active=0

phase_B_plane1_feasibility.interpretation: REAL64-RADIAL-FEASIBLE means only that the locked radial lane reproducibly reaches the pre-existing FLU stopping rule without a cutoff-active event and passes the listed structural diagnostics. It is not an independently evaluated equation residual, a flux-error bound, a conservation-accuracy proof, or a physical-solution accuracy claim.

future_stage4.component_rule: For each of R_rho, R_L, D_L and R_a independently: D_in < D_out_h when D_out_h > 0; if D_out_h is exactly zero, D_in must be exactly zero.
future_stage4.picard_authorization: Only an all-component qualified and exactly replayed REAL64 Stage-4 result may authorize a separately frozen direct Picard trajectory.

forbidden_actions: Do not run Dragon under this static-only freeze.
Do not construct A phi - q from ACA or PJJ records.
Do not use a residual magnitude, ULP count, angle, beta, improvement factor or balance magnitude as a new acceptance threshold.
Do not change MAXOUT, MAXINR, MCCG controls, ACCE, rebalancing, the inherited ACA cutoff, or the h/h2 tolerance pair.
Do not introduce relaxation, damping, fitting, clipping, flux floors or model terms.
Do not call a partial promotion a continuous REAL64 lane.
Do not reuse the forensic cap restart as a Stage-4 map state.
Do not run full Stage-4 or a Picard trajectory before separate qualification and authorization.
